statement: The 1102 (2026) motor's shaft C-clip clears a 2.3 mm hole, and its base is 11 mm across and 2 mm tall
rationale: BetaFPV's drawing gives the bell (13.8 mm), the height (13.6 mm) and the screw circle, but not the clip under the base (it scales to 1.6-2.1 mm on a drawing marked not to scale) nor the base's own size. Check with calipers when the motors arrive (P4).
